newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel Eddie Bauer October sales up.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel Eddie Bauer October sales up.

text.p: Spiegel Inc said October same store sales for its Eddie Bauer unit increased four percent.
For the year-to-date period ended October 26, 1996, same store sales for Eddie Bauer were flat.
Spiegel said that it continues to see strong response to Eddie Bauer's new EB Tek line in both the stores and catalogs.
Spiegel said total salesfor the four weeks ended October 26 were $240.2 million, up slightly from $240.1 million a year ago.
For the year-to-date period, total sales were $2.04 billion, down from $2.08 billion.
